name: Novice des provisions
design: Young adult female Yautja, compact rounded torso and thin long arms, pale cream head with dark side scales and tall alien forehead dome, thick scalp tendrils tied into a low short cluster. Four clearly readable facial mandibular lobes. Charcoal tunic with uneven cloth-panel skirt over brown trousers, red sash with a broad folded knot and brown shoulder cloth. Carries a small closed canvas provision sack in both hands at waist, tiny wooden spoon tucked under belt. Quiet patient standing pose, no armor.
